rule.statement: A contract or agreement for the future sale or purchase of land must be in writing and signed by the party making it, or by someone authorized by them, in the presence of a licensed notary public and two or more witnesses.
rule.supporting_quote: lease at will, or for any period not exceeding one month), nor any contract or agreement for the future sale or purchase of any land or other immovable property, and no notice, given under the provisions of the Thesawalamai Pre-emption Ordinance, of an intention or proposal to sell any undivided share or interest in land held in joint or common ownership, shall be of force or avail in law unless the same shall be in writing and signed by the party making the same, or by some person lawfully authorized by him or her in the presence of a licensed notary public and two or more witnesses present at the same time, and unless the execution of such writing, deed, or instrument be duly attested by such notary and witnesses.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2 of the Thesawalamai Pre-emption Ordinance
